title: Tiny, cute paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow underneath for depth -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='72' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#3a4a6b' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- main wing (top surface) -->
  <polygon points='30,55 78,40 55,62' fill='#f5f0e1' stroke='#d4cbb5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- fold line highlight -->
  <polygon points='30,55 78,40 62,56' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- lower wing / body -->
  <polygon points='30,55 55,62 48,72' fill='#e8e0cc' stroke='#c9bfa5' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- inner fold shade -->
  <polygon points='55,62 78,40 68,58' fill='#dcd3bc'/>
  <!-- nose tip accent -->
  <polygon points='78,40 68,58 73,46' fill='#f5f0e1'/>
  <!-- little cockpit window dot -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='52' r='3' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='51' r='1' fill='#b8e6f5'/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <line x1='20' y1='58' x2='28' y2='56' stroke='#8fa8c8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='65' x2='26' y2='64' stroke='#8fa8c8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='50' x2='29' y2='49' stroke='#8fa8c8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
